{{Main|1990 ATP Tour}}
The '''1990 ATP Championship Series, Single Week''' was a series of [[tennis]] tournament that was part of the [[1990 ATP Tour]], the elite tour for professional [[men]]'s tennis organised by the [[Association of Tennis Professionals]]. It formed the tier below the [[Grand Slam (tennis)|Grand Slam]] tournaments.
{{TOC limit|3}}
